summary: Hardened the historical farm_studio_api verdict classifier and CLI evidence loader. Completion now checks real turn captures; final candidates require matching stored-source SHA-256 and saved-candidate claims; fixed holdout success requires both report claims and a successful actual holdout capture. Added regression tests and preserved historical verdict overwrite protection.
tests_run: functions.tests: public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs, 6 tests passed, 0 failed
Regression tests exercised the real runCli file-loading and output-writing path using temporary workspace fixtures, including missing and malformed evidence and overwrite refusal
limitations: No child-process CLI invocation was run; the exported runCli implementation used by the CLI was tested directly under the provided tool permissions.
Source and capture files are treated as supplied evidence; this standalone verifier does not rerun the compiler or holdout and does not authenticate capture provenance.
Multi-file verdict publication is protected against overwriting existing files but is not an atomic transaction.
